title: Calibrium
line: An online watch shop, ready to take orders.
problem: Calibrium's website could show watches, but customers couldn't create an account, place an order or save favourites.
did: As a freelancer, I added everything a shopper needs: sign-up and login, a profile, checkout and payment, order history, favourites and automatic order confirmation emails.
outcome: Customers can now go from browsing to a paid order and a confirmation email in one smooth flow.
ai: I used Claude Code, an AI coding assistant, to speed up repetitive parts of the build. I agreed the work with the client, checked and tested every change myself, and was responsible for everything that went live.

story.title: The brief
story.body:
Calibrium's website could show its watches, but that was all. Customers couldn't create an account, place an order or save the watches they liked.

As a freelancer, my job was to turn it into a shop that could actually take orders.

story.title: What I added
story.body: I added everything a shopper needs, from start to finish: sign-up and login, a profile page, checkout and payment, order history, favourites, and an automatic confirmation email after every order.
story.callout: Browsing, paying and getting a confirmation email now happen in one smooth flow.

story.title: How I built it
story.body:
The shop is built with Next.js, React and TypeScript, together with Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Strapi CMS and Node.js.

I agreed the work with the client up front, then checked and tested every change myself before it went live.
